verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no OpenAI-compatible endpoint: all models are served at a proprietary `POST /v1/systemone` route. It also shows no documented migration path from other providers' SDKs into TypeSafe. The system-one adapter runs the other way: it swaps LLM APIs in behind TypeSafe's own API so users can compare the two. A community user reached Jev through OpenRouter and the changelog mentions AI-gateway examples, but these are third-party routing and an adjacent mention, not a first-party compatibility layer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible tooling at the platform, or follow a documented migration/adapter path from other providers' SDKs
